$comment: Maps Figma component sets in the Ledger Design System file to React components and props. Stands in for Code Connect, which needs an Organization plan. Node IDs are in the Components page of file S6tPQwUGxVVE1bOlAuFRPR.

State.note: default/hover/focus come from CSS; disabled -> disabled; loading -> loading
default/focus/filled come from CSS; error -> error="message"; disabled -> disabled

Input.example: <Input label="Card number" inputMode="numeric" helperText="We never store your card number." error={errors.card} />

State.note: unselected/selected -> checked; focus from CSS; disabled -> disabled

Radio card.example: <RadioCard name="method" value="card" title="Card" subtitle="Visa, Mastercard, Amex" icon={<CreditCard strokeWidth={1.5} />} checked={method === "card"} onChange={...} />

Card.example: <Card variant="summary" title="Order summary" total={{ label: "Total", value: "$128.00" }}>...</Card>

Alert.example: <Alert variant="error" title="Your card was declined" body="No charge was made. Try another card or contact your bank." action={{ label: "Use a different card", onClick: reset }} />

State.note: default/hover/focus come from CSS; disabled -> disabled

Text link.example: Billing address is the same as shipping. Change
Text link.note: Added as finding F2. Inline action inside a sentence. Not for navigation; use an <a> for links to other pages.

icon/*.note: Figma icon/<name> maps to the Lucide component of the same name in PascalCase: icon/credit-card -> CreditCard, icon/circle-alert -> CircleAlert. Always strokeWidth={1.5}.
